title: •Vader’s Anger
caption: •Vader’s Anger (V)
game_text: Target a Jedi present with Vader. Initiate an epic duel between them. Both players draw two destiny and add power. Loser (lowest total) is placed out of play and losing player loses 5 Force. OR If Vader just hit a Jedi, retrieve any three cards.
lore: Anger and aggression fuel the dark side of the Force.
copyright: © 2001 LUCASFILM LTD. & TM. TM, ® & © 2001 DECIPHER INC.
notes: Unique. Banner OUT OF PLAY INTERRUPT (printed base is a Used Or Lost Interrupt) — the renderer needs an Out Of Play Interrupt banner on the Dark Interrupt frame. 'OR If' with capital I as printed. Curly apostrophe in the slip's heading and caption (Vader’s). No inline icons; slip text matches the stub. Lore matches the scan. Base scan only at 350 px; copyright line SE-style with 2001, legible. Modern: V11-D-vadersanger.gif (745 px) is the later Virtual Set 11 Vader's Anger (V) — a USED INTERRUPT with different text, same art and lore; no Virtual Block image found.
